content.title: MARINERS.TV
content.text: Starting in 2026—watch Mariners Baseball via streaming, cable and satellite with Mariners TV! In-market Streaming: Stream Mariners games with no local blackouts on Mariners.TV if you’re in Washington, Idaho, Oregon, Alaska, Montana or Hawaii. Subject to national exclusivities. Sign up at Mariners.TV starting February 10. Available for $99.99/season or $19.99/month. Fans outside of the Pacific Northwest can still access Mariners games through MLB.TV. Cable, Satellite & Internet TV Providers: Mariners TV will be available through traditional cable, satellite and Internet TV providers, just like fans have watched Mariners Baseball in the past. How do I watch the Seattle Mariners in their home territory? To find a list of available carriers, please enter your zip code on the Channel Finder- Where to Watch Page below To stream Mariners games , please visit Mariners.TV for full details. Where to Watch Sign up for Email Alerts Complete the form here to receive emails about Mariners TV STREAMING FAQ Will I be able to stream Mariners games? Yes! Mariners.TV on MLB.TV is the new Mariners direct-to-consumer streaming platform, allowing in-market access to live Mariners games. No cable or satellite subscription needed; no contract required. Are there blackouts? In-market Mariners.TV subscribers can stream all local Mariners broadcasts with no blackouts. Please note national exclusivities apply. Mariners.TV subscribers who are outside the Mariners home territory can still watch Mariners games while they are traveling and are only subject to the opposing team’s local blackout restrictions, if applicable. How will it work and how much does it cost? Mariners.TV will work on a variety of devices through the MLB App and can be purchased at a discounted rate of $99.99 per year or $19.99 per month. Subscriptions for the 2026 season will be available starting February 10. Will I be able to watch Mariners games if I have a standard MLB.TV package, but not the Mariners.TV package? Mariners fans living within the Mariners home television territory must purchase a Mariners.TV subscription to stream Mariners games. Only fans who live outside the Mariners home market will be able to watch Mariners games with the standard MLB.TV package. CABLE, SATELLITE & INTERNET TV FAQ Can I still watch Mariners games through my cable, satellite or internet TV provider? Yes! Mariners TV will be available through traditional cable, satellite and Internet TV providers. Specific providers will be announced closer to the start of the season. What channel will Mariners TV be on? Specific channel locations will be announced closer to the start of the season. We expect that the channel locations will be located near other sports programming on your guide. Does Mariners TV replace ROOT SPORTS? Yes. Locally distributed Mariners games are now produced and distributed by Major League Baseball under the name Mariners TV beginning with the 2026 season. Can I authenticate access to Mariners games through the MLB App by using the credentials from my pay-TV provider? Coming soon! Please check back for updates. Blackout Policy Due to certain Major League Baseball national exclusivities, select regular season, special event, and Postseason games are unavailable on MLB.TV domestically and internationally. Seattle Mariners games streamed on Mariners.TV are subject to national exclusivities. Live audio of all 30 MLB teams is included with Mariners.TV subscriptions. Purchasers of Mariners.TV have access to in-market live-streaming games: click here for full details. Web: Select the Seattle Mariners game you wish to view from the Multimedia Center. You will be prompted to enter your Username and Password. As long as the computer meets the system requirements then you can log in with your registered email address and password to access your subscription from anywhere at any time. Sharing of your username and password is strictly prohibited. For more information, please click here. Mobile & Connected Devices To watch games on mobile and connected devices, download the MLB app and select the game you wish to view. You will be prompted to enter your Username and Password. Sharing of your username and password is strictly prohibited. For more information, please click here. Device Availability For a full list of supported devices click here Fan Support If you are having issues accessing a game or have questions about your account you can visit our full online Support Page. You can also call our toll-free support (866.244.2291), email by clicking here, on Social @MLBFanSupport or via Virtual Assistant. Payment Methods Accepted payment methods include: MasterCard, Visa, American Express, Discover, Masterpass, and PayPal. Please note: The payment and billing information entered above will be stored as your primary payment card in the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account. If you save alternative payment cards to the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account, you authorize us to charge such payment card(s) in the event we are unable to process charges to the primary payment card entered above. If the account number, expiration date or debit card account associated with your subscription changes, update it as soon as possible. Please also be aware, MLB may acquire this current information from our financial services partner(s) and update the Manage Subscriptions section of your MLB Account to include such revised payment information. Free Trial Policy You may cancel a 7-day risk-free trial of Mariners.TV Yearly or Mariners.TV Monthly any time during the 7-day window and will still have access to Mariners.TV for the full 7 days. If you do not cancel, you will be billed on the eighth day for the current Yearly or Monthly subscription price. MLB reserves the right to determine customer eligibility for trial memberships in its sole discretion. If you purchased the Mariners.TV monthly subscription, the payment card you have on file with us will be billed monthly on approximately the same monthly date that you originally purchased, with monthly billing for each month of the 2026 MLB season through and including October. You can verify your monthly billing date in your MLB Account under “Manage Subscriptions.” Cancellation Policy You may easily cancel your subscription any time before your next billing period in your MLB Account, under the Manage Subscriptions tab, or by contacting customer service at 866-244-2291 or contacting us here. (International Customers please call 315-203-6761). Auto-renewal Details Mariners.TV Yearly: By clicking “Buy and accept terms,” you agree to the MLB.com Terms of Use and the MLB.com Privacy Policy. You also agree that your subscription to Mariners.TV Yearly will automatically renew annually on or about March 1 at the then-current year’s regular full yearly price. You can cancel your automatic renewal any time before the billing period. Mariners.TV Monthly: By clicking “Buy & Accept Terms,” you agree to the MLB.com Terms of Use and the MLB.com Privacy Policy. You also agree that your subscription to Mariners.TV Monthly will renew monthly through and including September, and will automatically renew annually on or about March 1 each year at the then-current year’s regular full monthly price. You can cancel your automatic renewal any time before the billing period.
